notes.title: Level Editor support for "decimal commas"
notes.notes:
Users that had their Windows language/region set to a country which uses the "decimal comma" had their levels loaded with float values interpreted with commas rather than periods. This meant levels would not load correctly for users that had their languages/regions set to those countries. I never received any complaints about this, but noticed it after hearing about the same problem on another developer's project. 

It should be fixed now so enjoy!
